name: Fam-Trastuzumab Deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)
cyclesNote: Curative adjuvant: 14 cycles every 21 days for high-risk residual disease (DESTINY-Breast05). Metastatic setting: cycled every 21 days continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-M 4, 7 of 10; BINV-Q 2, 3, 4, 10 of 15)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (trastuzumab linked to topoisomerase-1 inhibitor deruxtecan): (1) Curative adjuvant setting: Category 1 preferred for HER2-positive early breast cancer with high-risk residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy (DESTINY-Breast05); (2) Metastatic setting: Category 1 preferred for 2L+ HER2-positive disease (DESTINY-Breast03); Category 1 preferred for HER2-low metastatic breast cancer (IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH-) after prior chemotherapy/endocrine therapy (DESTINY-Breast04); and Category 2A recommended for HER2-ultralow (IHC 0+) metastatic disease (DESTINY-Breast06). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026.

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes IDC, ILC, and HR-negative/positive)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: T-DXd is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; provide two- or three-drug antiemetic prophylaxis (e.g. 5-HT3 receptor antagonist + dexamethasone ± NK1 antagonist) prior to infusion.

supportiveCare: Pulmonary / ILD vigilance: monitor actively for signs and symptoms of interstitial lung disease (ILD) / pneumonitis (cough, dyspnea, fever, new lung infiltrates on CT). Hold T-DXd for suspected ILD; permanently discontinue for confirmed grade ≥2 ILD/pneumonitis.
Antiemetics: provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF at baseline and every 3 months during therapy. Hold for significant LVEF decline.
monitoring: Chest CT and pulmonary symptoms for ILD/pneumonitis at baseline and periodically
CBC with differential before each cycle (neutropenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia)
LVEF at baseline and every 3 months during treatment
Hepatic function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) before each cycle
clearanceChecks: LVEF (≥ 50% and within normal institutional limits)
pulmonary status (absence of suspected or confirmed pneumonitis)

doseModificationRules.condition: confirmed interstitial lung disease (ILD) / pneumonitis of any symptomatic grade (grade ≥ 2)
doseModificationRules.text: Permanently discontinue T-DXd in patients diagnosed with symptomatic (Grade 2 or greater) ILD/pneumonitis. Initiate systemic corticosteroids (prednisone ≥1 mg/kg/day or equivalent) immediately for at least 14 days followed by gradual taper. For asymptomatic Grade 1 ILD, hold until resolution and consider resuming with dose reduction.

doseModificationRules.condition: LVEF decline: absolute decrease > 16% from baseline or LVEF below institutional lower limit with absolute decrease > 10%
doseModificationRules.text: Withhold T-DXd. Repeat LVEF in 3 weeks. If LVEF recovers, resume. If persistent decline, permanently discontinue.
Hold until resolution to grade ≤ 1. Resume at next lower dose level: first reduction 4.4 mg/kg; second reduction 3.2 mg/kg.

drugs.name: Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10 and BINV-Q 10 of 15. Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV Day 1, cycled every 21 days (for 14 cycles in curative adjuvant residual setting; continuous until progression in metastatic setting).
